text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello, little ones! Today we're going to<n>teach you
all about traffic rules!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Take a good look over there. It<n>looks like
those other Umamusume<n>teachers are playing tag.
Now look very<n>carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: Doubtful Child
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure they're teachers? They're<n>really
small! As small as me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Grr... I ain't dat small!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And I'm trying to become a mature<n>woman, so
why am I playing the kid<n>role?! This is lame!

text_block_list.name: Инари Ван
text_block_list.text:
I do want some answers from the casting<n>
department... but remember, this is for<n>the
kiddos. We need to tough it out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm over here! Ehehe, you're no match for<n>my
evasive maneuvers!

text_block_list.name: Райс Шауэр
text_block_list.text: W-wait... Oh, no! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Rrrraaagh! Get outta da way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! Those two almost crashed into<n>each
other! Umamusume can't make<n>sudden stops when
they're running, so<n>make sure you don't rush out
in front of<n>them!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But my mom says you should never run<n>at full
speed outside!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Umamusume should only go<n>all out in
certain places. Yer a good girl<n>for followin' her
advice!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Do you all know about Umamusume<n>lanes that
roads have? They're special<n>lanes where
Umamusume can run at full<n>speed. Be absolutely
sure not to stumble<n>into those lanes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
So we just have to look both ways<n>before we cross
an Umamusume lane,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not only then—a running Umamusume is<n>
dangerous wherever she is! Just take a<n>look over
there.

text_block_list.name: Инари Ван
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! Hurry it up!

text_block_list.name: Райс Шауэр
text_block_list.text: Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash! Thump, clatter...

text_block_list.name: Инари Ван
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What a crazy crash!

text_block_list.name: Райс Шауэр
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! It's all my fault! I... I only ever<n>bring
misfortune!

text_block_list.name: Инари Ван
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, this is all part of the show. Look,<n>Trainer's
totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
See? Even when Umamusume aren't<n>runnin' at full
speed, we're still real fast.<n>And we're stronger
than we look, ya<n>know. Even if a grown-up
stepped out in<n>front of us, they'd get sent flyin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Never jump out in front of a running<n>Umamusume.
And growing Umamusume<n>must always be aware
of their<n>surroundings while running. Make sure<n>
you follow these rules!

text_block_list.name: The Children
text_block_list.text: 'Kaaay!
